race.description: Cirka Melbourne Cup Carnival Country Fnl Hcp (Bm80)
race.comment: BEL MEZYAAN (4) won his way into this Final with a strong victory on Bendigo Cup day, coming from off the speed on a day that suited those leading, getting the upper hand late to score by a long neck. Up to a mile suits ideally now and he should get a lovely run midfield. SULEK (9) is improving third-up, having edged out YAM by a head at Geelong in good time. Stays down in the weights and will be very hard to hold out late. OUR JUSTIFY (13) returns fresh after five weeks which is interesting placement but he's flying with two straight wins, and is a horse still on the up. ROSA AOTEAROA (5), just a long neck behind BEL MEZYAAN last week. Up to a mile is a query but Zahra takes the ride and he'll be up on speed. WETUMPKA (14) draws awfully but has upside and can figure.
